disposition.summary: **Promoted Maya1.1.24 /25deec5 on retained ROCm7.2.3.** Both retained Maya-S32K profiles passed native and normal gates. GLM keeps MMQ after the newly enabled gfx1100 fused path failed parity; source19 rollback is preserved. Other engines, weights, contexts, memory guards and the DSH Strata default are unchanged.
disposition.normal_summary: Actual unchanged Desktop entry→Ptyxis→managed worker/original browser UI passed for GLM→DeepSeek→GLM, including model selector, original assets/metrics, authenticated gateway and blocked runtime/context/port updates. Exact deployed binary/source/config fingerprints matched. First direct GIO attempt ended beforeAPI readiness; its scope logs are preserved; detached GIO retry passed. Cause of the first termination is not established. Final owned-worker cleanup is verified separately.
